BJP Wins Majority of Deputy Mayor Seats in Rajasthan Civic Polls

In Rajasthan's deputy mayor elections held on Monday, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) secured victory in six out of seven municipal corporations. The Congress party won only in Bikaner. Despite the BJP's overall win, significant differences in ward numbers and votes were observed in several corporations during the mayoral elections.
